items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I heard of him. I never met him.

ctx.x: Butter Beans and Susie? I know them from when the lyrics time I was a kid, then I would tell you, I'd go to the lyrics place to come here. I never know a person. Did you hear Pigmeat Markham? Yeah.
I heard of him. I never met him. You never worked with him.
No. I never worked with him. No. I never worked with him.
